mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (high monthly job gains in PAYEMS and low unemployment in UNRATE) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1600 thousand units), the demand for consumer goods and services accelerates, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it indicates an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signal a persistent inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions or economic slowdowns reduce corporate output and profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
